package.name: PanVK Mali-G2-test47-regs32-1ef9268-dc87e198 (Mesa 27.0.0-devel)
package.description: PanVK for Mali Bifrost and Valhall GPUs on the stock Arm kbase kernel driver, based on Mesa 27.0.0-devel.
package.author: JimVulkan

change: v15 compiler: preload and blend-link registers moved from r48-r63 to r16-r31 and 32-register allocation uses contiguous r0-r31, removing the forced 64-register mode (thread occupancy doubles for shaders that fit in 32). Also includes the diagnostics cleanup a2b3fc3.

tests.microbench_timing: inconclusive, DVFS noise; trivial shaders not latency bound
